plugins.description: Build, run, test, debug, instrument, and implement local macOS apps using Xcode, SwiftUI, AppKit interop, unified logging, and shell-first desktop workflows.
Build iOS apps with workflows for App Intents, SwiftUI UI work, Simulator mirroring, performance profiling, leak investigation, and simulator debugging.

Turn early product ideas into reviewable prototypes: confirm the brief, explore product directions, audit user flows, research user friction, prototype from a URL, and make static screenshots interactive.
Explore campaign ideas, concept images, mood boards, product placements, ad directions, listing images, social posts, launch assets, and reusable visual styles.
Turn analytical questions into validated answers, dashboards, reports, notebooks, KPI frameworks, metric diagnostics, market sizing, data-quality checks, and product/business recommendations.
Practical sales workflows for meeting prep, post-call follow-up, account signals, deal strategy, forecast review, competitive briefs, CRM context, and reusable seller preferences.
Figma workflows for design-to-code, file inspection, Code Connect templates, variables/tokens, design system generation, diagrams, FigJam, Slides, and component library work.
Control the Codex in-app browser for local development pages and files: open, navigate, inspect, click, type, screenshot, and verify localhost or file:// targets.
Control desktop apps through Codex Computer Use: screenshots, accessibility-driven app operation, and scoped GUI tasks on macOS. Review before enabling because it can affect host apps.
AI image and media generation workflows using Fal models. Use as a reference for building local video/image pipelines and future KIE/Kier AI replacements.
